test_series_set_value: test the Series._set_value method with DatetimeIndex and object-dtype Index for GH#1561 and GH#51363
test_set_value_dt64: test the Series._set_value method with a datetime64 index key and verify the assigned value
test_set_value_str_index: test the Series._set_value method with a string index key and compare against .loc assignment
test_series_set_value_nan: test the Series._set_value method assigning np.nan to an object-dtype series with datetime keys
test_series_set_value_compare_loc: test that Series._set_value produces the same result as .loc assignment for string index keys
